steps.text: Hi! I'm Boyfriend, and I'll be showing you around Vortex Engine. This is the main menu: UP/DOWN pick, ENTER opens.
Story Mode plays the weeks in order, Freeplay any song you want, Online lets you play against a friend, and Mods is where mods are turned on and off.
Down here on the left are the achievements. LEFT/RIGHT pick the corners with the keyboard.
The options open right over the menu, and the X up top closes the game.
And 7 opens the editors: charts, characters, stages, weeks... Every screen with this button has a tutorial of its own!
